reuse.why: Adds the tag check to the existing isExcludedFromBulkActions predicate and reuses getBudgetData for copyPreviousMonth instead of a new exclusion path.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the category query into getBulkActionCategories; the only remaining repetition is the notes LEFT JOIN written in both getBudgetData and getBulkActionCategories.

placement.why: The rule and the shared category selection live in budget/actions.ts next to the existing exclusion predicate used by the month-wide actions.

scope.why: Confined to the bulk-action exclusion, its test and a release note; the average actions' switch from SQL hidden filters to the shared predicate is part of routing them through the same rule.

maintainability.why: One predicate and one selection function now decide which categories every month-wide action touches, so the next exclusion rule is a one-line change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through isExcludedFromBulkActions.

disguised_duplication.where: The notes join appears in getBudgetData and getBulkActionCategories as two different queries over different tables; no logic is reshaped to hide a copy.

one_place.where: hasFixedTag inside isExcludedFromBulkActions in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth via getBudgetData and by the other five actions via getBulkActionCategories.
